title: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production
why_read: Business/product news about Tesla halting Cybertruck production, with little direct technical content for engineers.
analysis: This is a news item about Tesla reportedly winding down production of the Cybertruck. It's a business and manufacturing story rather than a technical one, though it may interest engineers following EV industry trends.
